name: Shanghai New Vision Microelectronics Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai New Vision Microelectronics Co., Ltd, engages in the design, research and development, and sales of display chips in China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Macau. The company offers TFT-LCD display driver chips (DDIC/TDDI), AMOLED display driver chips, touch chips, and MicroLED chips used in tablets, automotive, IT equipment, and commercial displays. It also provides display driver chips, display power management chips, and timing control chips. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
